description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open-source testing management system. It provides functionality for updating test case versions linked to test plans, processing test cases, test suites, and test plans, along with user interface initialization and right management. It handles the backend logic for updating test case versions, including filtering, linked item management, and GUI setup.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves request parameters and session data related to test plan and test cases.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Performs the update of selected test case versions linked to a test plan, updating relevant database tables.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI configuration and state variables for the test case update page.

methods.name: processTestSuite
methods.description: Processes and retrieves filtered view data for a test suite within a test plan.

methods.name: doUpdateAllToLatest
methods.description: Updates all test case versions in a test plan to their latest versions, modifying linked items across multiple tables.

methods.name: processTestCase
methods.description: Processes and retrieves details of a specific test case within a test plan, including linked versions and filtering.

methods.name: processTestPlan
methods.description: Retrieves linked and newest test case versions associated with a test plan, along with related path info.

methods.name: tideUpForGUI
methods.description: Enhances the structured output data to assist GUI display, including update eligibility and linked version status.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies user rights for accessing and modifying test plan data.
